besluite.fout: The participle of the separable compound verb saammeng is written apart.
besluite.rede: AWS writes saamgemeng as one word; the meaning is unchanged and the protected sentence elsewhere is not touched.

besluite.fout: A long om...te clause acting as subject runs straight into the main verb without a pause.
besluite.rede: The comma marks where the subject clause ends and makes the sentence easier to read on first pass.
Tot as a conjunction is standard, natural Afrikaans, so totdat is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: Mag for possibility copies English 'may' and can be read as permission.
besluite.rede: Kan is the natural Afrikaans for possibility and the meaning stays the same.

besluite.fout: Missing comma before en joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: AWS 2017 house rule requires the comma here; the protected wording stays intact.
Dit lyk of is standard Afrikaans and reads naturally, so asof is only different.
Tot as a conjunction is standard and natural, and dropping it matches decision 3.

besluite.fout: The concessive al-clause runs into the main clause without a separating comma.
besluite.rede: The comma separates main clause and concessive clause and helps the reader without moving the meaning.
